card.name: Linking words after drug or study names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "is", "was" and "and" in label text. They come right after a brand name or study name, or inside bracketed section cross-references like [see Warnings and Precautions (5.3) and ...].

modes.label: Verb after a product or study name
modes.description: "is" or "was" right after a brand name or a study label, starting a statement about it.
modes.example: (loading and maintenance) of NUZYRA<< is>> described in Table 2 below.

modes.label: Link inside section cross-references
modes.description: "and" or "Patient" joining section names inside a bracketed [see ...] reference.
modes.example: In patients with volume depletion, correct this condition before initiating STEGLATRO [see Warnings and Precautions (5.3)<< and>> Use in Specific Populations (8.

modes.label: Question mark ending a heading
modes.description: A question mark closing a heading question about ingredients.
modes.example: What are the ingredients in tranylcypromine sulfate tablets<<?>> Active Ingredient: tranylcyprom
